Fazlur Rahman Babu coming to TDS Facebook Live
2017-07-12T00:00:00+06:00 | Staff Correspondent
https://www.thedailystar.net/1971-liberation-war-articles/fazlur-rahman-babu-coming-tds-facebook-live-1431655

Fazlur Rahman Babu is a household name for the country's TV audience, along with the occasional but incredible big screen presence, in films like “Shonkhonaad” (for which he won the National Film Award) to last year's “Oggatonama”. The seasoned theatre artiste has also made a name as a singer, be it for playback or his own albums in his sonorous, soulful voice.

The veteran actor most recently created a stir among the audience with his heart-wrenching performance of a struggling middle-class father in Adnan Al Rajeev's “Bikal Bela'r Pakhi”, which gained heaps of praise for him on the social media.

To bring him closer to the Facebook followers of The Daily Star, we are bringing Fazlur Rahman Babu to this month's episode of “Ask Me Anything”, The Daily Star's monthly Facebook Live Session. The veteran actor will be Live on facebook.com/dailystarnews on Thursday, July 13 from 6:30pm, talking to you all about his journey as an actor and his role in “Bikal Bela'r Pakhi”.

Anyone connected to The Daily Star's Facebook page can join in on the conversation and talk to him directly.
